Had a late night? Lack of sleep can result in dry, tired-looking skin. Place PDRN+ Toner Pads on forehead and chin to deeply hydrate and soothe while placing Vitamin C Toner Pads on undereyes and cheeks to depuff and brighten. Remove after 15 minutes for radiant, refreshed skin.

A note from Glow:

Our toner pads are intentionally ultra-thin, made from plant-derived cellulose, and soaked in 3 full bottles of serum; therefore, some movement during shipping is normal and they may arrive slightly shuffled. This is expected and does not impact the formula, saturation, or results.

Storage and Travel:

Our toner pads are generously saturated, so we recommend storing the jar upright with the inner disc placed and lid securely closed to prevent leakage. When traveling, use tweezers to grasp the desired number of pads and insert them in a leak-proof container.

What are toner pads, and how are they different from liquid toners?

Toner pads are pre-saturated, single-use pads designed to take the guesswork out of your routine. Each pad is infused with a precise amount of formula, so you’re getting consistent results every time you use one.

Unlike liquid toners, which can be over-applied or unevenly distributed, toner pads allow the formula to sit directly on the skin for longer, more even contact. This helps improve absorption and makes results reliable and repeatable.

Why did Glow Recipe create toner pads?

We created toner pads to deliver the results of a Korean facial in a simplified, everyday format. Inspired by mini sheet masks, each pad is designed to be placed on targeted areas and left on for up to 15 minutes for precise, focused treatment.

By standardizing how much product you use and where it’s applied, toner pads make skincare more intuitive, effective, and gentle. True to Glow Recipe’s philosophy, they allow you to treat your skin day by day: mix, match, or multi-mask based on what your skin needs most.

How do toner pads fit into a skincare routine?

Toner pads are inspired by Korean skincare rituals that emphasize hydration, gentle layering, and skin respect over harsh techniques. Rather than rubbing or scrubbing, these pads are designed to be placed directly on the skin and left on for up to 5 minutes.

This “soak and absorb” approach allows the formula to do the work, supporting better hydration, ingredient absorption, and barrier health without unnecessary friction.

Do toner pads exfoliate the skin?

Yes, but very gently! The soft, plant-derived cellulose pad provides light physical exfoliation to help remove surface debris, while the formulas themselves deliver targeted chemical exfoliation or treatment benefits depending on the variant.

This combination helps smooth and refine skin without the harshness of traditional exfoliating scrubs.<

How often should toner pads be used?

Each toner pad formula is designed to be gentle enough for daily use, but frequency ultimately depends on your skin type and comfort level. If you’re new to exfoliating or treatment pads, starting slowly and building up is always a good approach.

Are toner pads suitable for sensitive skin?

Yes. All three toner pad formulas were developed with skin tolerance in mind and are suitable for sensitive skin. That said, everyone’s skin is different — so we always recommend patch testing, especially if you’re new to exfoliating or brightening ingredients.

What makes toner pads a more sustainable option?

Toner pads help reduce waste by eliminating the need for disposable cotton rounds and excess accessories. The controlled dosing also helps prevent product overuse, ensuring the formula is used efficiently rather than wasted.

Toner Pad Movement

Our toner pads are made from ultra-thin, 100% plant-derived cellulose and are generously saturated with serum. Because of this lightweight, flexible design — and the high level of formula in each jar — some movement during shipping is completely normal. They may arrive slightly shuffled or out of order, but this does not affect the formula, saturation, or performance.

Toner Pad Storage

To prevent leaking, store the jar upright with the lid tightly closed. Because each jar is filled with a generous amount of serum, storing it on its side or upside down may cause minor leakage. Always replace the inner disc before closing the lid to help maintain freshness and saturation.

What skin concerns do the PDRN+ Repair + Soothe Toner Pads address?

These toner pads are designed to help calm stressed, irritated, damaged, or compromised skin. They focus on soothing visible redness, restoring comfort, and supporting long-term skin barrier health — making them ideal for moments when skin feels out of balance or needs extra care.

What makes this formula different from other calming or barrier products?

This formula is inspired by Korean skincare principles that focus on barrier-first recovery and gentle, cumulative results rather than band-aid fixes. Instead of just calming skin temporarily, it’s designed to support skin repair and resilience over time.

The toner pad format allows the soothing, regenerative ingredients to stay in direct contact with the skin for several minutes, helping them absorb evenly without rubbing or irritation. The result is a treatment that feels instantly comforting while quietly helping skin recover and rebalance with continued use.

What does PDRN do for the skin?

PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) is made of DNA fragments that help support the skin’s natural repair and recovery processes. When applied topically, PDRN interacts with key skin receptors involved in barrier repair and renewal, helping improve skin resilience, comfort, and overall recovery.

In this formula, Vegan PDRN helps strengthen the skin barrier, calm visible redness, and support long-term skin health, making it especially beneficial for stressed, sensitized, or compromised skin.

What is Vegan PDRN, and why is it used in this formula?

Vegan PDRN is a plant-derived regenerative complex made from white rice and prickly pear. It helps support skin repair and renewal, especially for skin that feels sensitized, dry, or compromised.

Unlike animal-derived PDRN or salmon-based ingredients, this vegan alternative is highly purified and consistent, helping reduce the risk of irritation while aligning with Glow Recipe’s cruelty-free values.

How does this formula help soothe visible redness and irritation?

The Centella Calming Complex, which combines centella asiatica and panthenol, helps visibly calm redness, smooth rough texture, and reinforce the skin barrier. These ingredients are well-loved for their ability to comfort stressed skin and support recovery without heaviness.

What are the firming and restoring actives in this formula?

A blend of adenosine, glycerin, and beta glucan works together to deliver antioxidant-rich hydration and restorative benefits. Glycerin replenishes moisture, beta glucan supports barrier repair and comfort, and adenosine helps visibly firm and revitalize the skin over time!

How does this formula compare to other PDRN-based products?

While PDRN is often used for hydration and repair, it can come with variability and potential allergenic concerns. This formula uses a plant-derived, vegan mucin alternative that offers the same skin-supporting benefits with greater consistency, purity, and suitability for sensitive skin.

Is this suitable for compromised or sensitized skin?

Yes. This formula was developed specifically with compromised and sensitized skin in mind. Its gentle, fragrance-free approach and focus on barrier repair make it a great option when skin feels stressed, reactive, or in need of recovery

Can all skin types use the PDRN+ Repair + Soothe Toner Pads?

Yes. These toner pads are suitable for multiple skin types, including combination, normal, dry, oily, and sensitive skin types.

When is this toner pad a good choice in a routine?

This toner pad is especially helpful when skin feels irritated, over-exfoliated, dehydrated, or compromised — whether due to environmental stress, active use, or general sensitivity. It can be used as a calming reset step to help bring skin back into balance.
